name: Collective Defiance
oracle_text:
Escalate {1} (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Target player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards.
• Collective Defiance deals 4 damage to target creature.
• Collective Defiance deals 3 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
blocked_sentences: • Collective Defiance deals 3 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

needs.what: one target spec spanning players and permanents whose player half and permanent half carry separate filters: the player half restricted to opponents, the permanent half any planeswalker on the battlefield regardless of controller ("target opponent or planeswalker", 115.4)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: kind "any" applies one selector to both halves: _player_allowed reads its `controller` clause for the seat and resolve_pool/matches read the same `controller` for the object, so controller "opponent" + types [Planeswalker] wrongly excludes your own planeswalkers, and omitting controller wrongly lets you target yourself. `any_of` branches are ANDed with the top-level controller and are not consulted by the player half; two separate targets would target twice and need both legal.
